headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 15, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a shutout loss to the Chicago Cubs, with Seiya Suzuki leading the Cubs' offense. In other news, the Cincinnati Reds secured a narrow 1-0 victory over the Miami Marlins, with Chase Burns pitching 7.0 innings of shutout baseball. The Pittsburgh Pirates snapped the Boston Red Sox's winning streak with an 8-4 victory, while the Chicago White Sox took down the Detroit Tigers 9-5.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with Abner Uribe of the Milwaukee Brewers placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. The Seattle Mariners have also placed Colt Emerson on the 10-day injured list with left wrist tendon inflammation. Other teams have made roster moves, including the Baltimore Orioles acquiring Harold Rivas in a trade with the Boston Red Sox.

The White Sox's Miguel Vargas hit two home runs, including his 27th of the season, and drove in three runs in their 9-5 victory over the Tigers. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Red Sox offense with a 3-hit performance, including a home run and 2 RBIs, in their 8-4 loss to the Pirates.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 0-3 loss to the Chicago Cubs, marking their final score. Seiya Suzuki led the Cubs' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Marlins in Thrilling 1-0 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a narrow win over the Miami Marlins, with Chase Burns pitching 7.0 innings of shutout baseball, striking out 8 batters and allowing 4 hits. Eugenio Suárez led the Reds' offense with a double that scored the game's only run.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Red Sox 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 8-4 victory over the Boston Red Sox, snapping their opponent's winning streak. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Red Sox offense with a 3-hit performance, including a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Tigers 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Miguel Vargas leading the offense. Vargas hit two home runs, including his 27th of the season, and drove in three runs.

top_news.title: **Brewers' Abner Uribe Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-handed pitcher Abner Uribe has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. The move is retroactive to August 11, 2026.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
